sentences.l2: 近年来，社区团购迅速兴起，悄然重塑了城市家庭的日常采买方式。
sentences.l1: In recent years, community group buying has risen rapidly, quietly reshaping the way urban families do their daily shopping.

sentences.l2: 其核心并非某项技术突破，而是一种以邻里关系为纽带的信任机制：团长多为小区内的全职妈妈或退休居民，她们凭借长期积累的熟人网络，在群聊中发布商品信息、统计订单，并将次日达的货品集中配送至自家楼下的自提点。
sentences.l1: Its core is not some technological breakthrough, but a trust mechanism with neighborly relationships as its bond: group leaders are mostly full-time mothers or retired residents of the compound, who, relying on their long-accumulated network of acquaintances, post product information and tally orders in the group chat, and have next-day-delivery goods delivered in bulk to the pickup point downstairs from their own homes.

sentences.l2: 对消费者而言，这种模式同时缓解了价格与便利的双重焦虑——平台以预售制压缩库存风险，从而让出部分利润；省去最后一公里的配送成本，又使生鲜价格明显低于传统商超。
sentences.l1: For consumers, this model eases the double anxiety of price and convenience at the same time: the platform uses pre-sale to reduce inventory risk and thereby gives up part of its profit; and cutting out the cost of last-mile delivery makes the price of fresh produce clearly lower than at traditional supermarkets.

sentences.l2: 更值得关注的是其社会效应：原本彼此疏离的现代邻里，因一次次取货时的寒暄而重新建立起最低限度的往来。
sentences.l1: More worth noting is its social effect: modern neighbors who were originally distant from one another have, through the small talk of each pickup, re-established a minimal level of contact.

sentences.l2: 当然，团长的权威高度依赖个人信誉，一旦品控失守，社群的黏性与复购率便会迅速瓦解，这或许正是该模式难以规模化扩张的隐忧。
sentences.l1: Of course, a group leader's authority depends heavily on personal reputation, and once quality control slips, the community's stickiness and repurchase rate will quickly collapse, which is perhaps exactly the hidden worry that makes this model hard to scale up.
